arguments.command:
python3 - <<'EOF'
import re
src=open('docs/inputs.md').read()
body=src[src.index('## Inputs'):]
# links relative to docs/ -> relative to repo root
body=re.sub(r'\]\((?!https?:|\.\./|#)([^)]+)\)', lambda m: '](docs/'+m.group(1)+')', body)
body=body.replace('](../','](')
intro="""Only `github_token` is necessary. All other inputs have a default or are optional. [`action.yml`](action.yml) defines the inputs, and [`src/defaults.ts`](src/defaults.ts) holds the defaults. Tests ([`src/action-docs.test.ts`](src/action-docs.test.ts) and [`src/defaults.test.ts`](src/defaults.test.ts)) make sure that the table below agrees with both files.

"""
body=body.replace('## Inputs\n\n','## Inputs\n\n'+intro,1)
body=body.replace('### How pi-action reads input values','### How pi-action reads input values')
r=open('README.md').read()
r=r.replace('## Documentation\n', body.rstrip()+'\n\n## Documentation\n',1)
r=r.replace('| [Inputs and outputs](docs/inputs.md) | The reference for all action inputs and outputs, with their defaults |\n','')
open('README.md','w').write(r)
EOF
git rm -q docs/inputs.md
sed -i 's#\[Inputs and outputs\](inputs.md)#[Inputs](../README.md#inputs)#g; s#(inputs.md)#(../README.md\#inputs)#g' docs/*.md
grep -rn "inputs.md\|README.md#inputs" docs README.md CONTRIBUTING.md | cut -c1-160
